title: Airflow Connection and Variable Errors
dataSources: Airflow logs (`airflow:scheduler`, `airflow:worker`, `airflow:task`), REST API `/dags/*/dagRuns`, StatsD counters (`airflow:statsd`), and metadata tables via DB Connect.
app: Airflow task/scheduler logs via Universal Forwarder; Airflow REST API (`/api/v1`) and StatsD/OpenTelemetry metrics via HEC scripted inputs; Airflow metadata database (`dag_run`, `task_instance`, `job`) via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=airflow:task ("The conn_id" AND "isn't defined") OR "Variable * does not exist"
| rex "conn_id `(?<conn_id>[^`]+)`"
| stats count as errors by conn_id, dag_id
| sort - errors
description: Detects tasks failing because a referenced Airflow connection or variable is missing, a common cause of environment-specific pipeline breakage after a migration.
value: Missing connections fail pipelines in ways unit tests miss; surfacing them by DAG accelerates fixes after promotions between environments.
implementation: Ingest task logs; schedule every 30 minutes and alert on new missing-connection errors, especially right after deployments.
visualization: Table of conn_id/DAG by error count.
grandmaExplanation: We catch pipeline jobs that break because a saved login or setting is missing, so it can be added back quickly.
